cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've cancelled Sunday after Mum made the bed again. When a shift changes, you tell the host first. Please ring her.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what I did last month. You disappeared and I explained. This time, start with 'I'm sorry' and give her another date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know my next free Sunday. Can you check with her later?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Put a reminder in your phone for when the rota arrives. Please enter it now. I'm not booking your next visit or explaining why there isn't one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 teaches host notification; A3 scripts proper repair and A5 corrects renewed delegation by assigning future planning to B.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's request repeats last month's softened cancellation; B4's unknown rota leads A5 to a reminder instead of taking over.

relationship.evidence: B2 fears hurting Mum and B4 has a real scheduling uncertainty.

heightening.evidence: A5 raises the consequence to withdrawing both future booking and explanation.
